description: A small white block sits on the table in front of a larger white chair-like model with a vertical back and a protruding peg on its left side. The left hand reaches in from the left, grasps the small block as a left-hand object, and brings it rightward to align with the peg, while the right hand moves in to steady the larger chair model as a right-hand object; the left hand then presses the block onto the peg and releases, leaving it attached.
